programs.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programs.desc: Chef, cookbook author and TV host Sara Moulton presents helpful hints for preparing quick and easy healthy meals at home. Episodes feature ideas for Sunday suppers, for one-pot meals, and for preparing flavor-packed meals using only five ingredients. Some recipes include pork tournedos with sage and prosciutto, steamed mussels in curried coconut broth, a fried-catfish bacon/lettuce/tomato sandwich, and a salad of grilled-salmon, arugula and grilled corn.
